```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(arrow)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
```

This document creates updated plots useing the updated entry and exit data from 01_iucn_aquax_eez_overlap_db.qmd. It focuses on the scenario RCP 4.5 for the year 2050 and a threshold of 1 pxl for presence/absence of species in EEZ. The plots include maps of species entry and exit pixels, bivariate plots of species entry vs exit, and calculations of species change by EEZ and sovereign nation.

## Read in at-risk species data

```{r}
# Spp in EEZs
spp_eez_pxl_count <- read_csv(here("data/iucn_threatened_spp_eez_pxls_061626.csv"))
```

```{r}
# Spp EEZ entry/exit pixels (EEZ regions)
spp_entry_pxls <- read_rds(here("data/iucn_atrisk_1pxlthres_entry_pxls_091626.rds"))
spp_exit_pxls <- read_rds(here("data/iucn_atrisk_1pxlthres_exit_pxls_091626.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Spp EEZ entry/exit pixels (EEZ territories)
spp_entry_pxls_ter <- read_rds(here("data/iucn_atrisk_rcp452050_1pxlthres_ter_entry_pxls_101426.rds"))
spp_exit_pxls_ter <- read_rds(here("data/iucn_atrisk_rcp452050_1pxlthres_ter_exit_pxls_101426.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Species range area
```

## Read in EEZs

```{r}
library(rnaturalearth)
globe <- ne_countries(scale = "large", returnclass = "sf")
#globe <- ne_coastline(scale = "large", returnclass = "sf")
```

```{r}
eez <- st_read('/Users/abowd/World_EEZ_v12_20231025_gpkg/eez_v12.gpkg')
```

```{r}
eez <- st_read('/home/shares/usgs-cap-rangeshifts/spatial/World_EEZ_v12_20231025_gpkg/eez_v12.gpkg')
```

```{r}
# Get list of EEZ IDs that are not overlapping claims (i.e., POL_TYPE = 200NM)
eez_200nm_list <- eez %>% 
  filter(POL_TYPE == "200NM") %>% 
  pull(MRGID)

# Add Ukraine to list
eez_200nm_list <- c(eez_200nm_list, 5695)
```

```{r}
eez_simple <- eez %>% 
  dplyr::select(MRGID, GEONAME, SOVEREIGN1, TERRITORY1, ISO_TER1, ISO_SOV1, MRGID_SOV1, MRGID_TER1) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  filter(MRGID %in% eez_200nm_list) %>% 
  # For the territories that don't have ISO or IDs (like HI and AK), assign to SOV 
  mutate(MRGID_TER1 = ifelse(is.na(ISO_TER1), MRGID_SOV1, MRGID_TER1),
        ISO_TER1 = ifelse(is.na(ISO_TER1), ISO_SOV1, ISO_TER1))

eez_simple_sf <- eez %>% 
  dplyr::select(MRGID, GEONAME) %>% 
  filter(MRGID %in% eez_200nm_list)
```

```{r}
# Create shapefile of EEZ territories and sovereign nations for plotting
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

eez_terr_sov_sf <- eez %>% 
  dplyr::select(MRGID, GEONAME, SOVEREIGN1, TERRITORY1, ISO_TER1, ISO_SOV1) %>% 
  filter(MRGID %in% eez_200nm_list) %>% 
  mutate(ISO_TER1 = ifelse(is.na(ISO_TER1), ISO_SOV1, ISO_TER1)) %>% 
  st_make_valid() %>%
  group_by(ISO_TER1, ISO_SOV1) %>%
  summarize(regions = n())

sf_use_s2(TRUE)
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = eez_terr_sov_sf, aes(fill = ISO_TER1)) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") 
```

## Compare species entry/exit thresholds

```{r}
eez_spp_pxls_long_1pxl <- spp_eez_pxl_count %>% 
  # Drop overlapping claim EEZs
  filter(MRGID %in% eez_200nm_list) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("n_RCP"),
               names_to = "scenario",
               values_to = "pxl_count") %>% 
  mutate(scenario = str_remove(scenario, "n_")) %>% 
  # Replace NA with 0, otherwise will be assigned to "continued presence"
  mutate(pxl_count = replace_na(pxl_count, 0),
         n_current = replace_na(n_current, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(spp_change = case_when(n_current < 1 &  pxl_count >= 1 ~ 'entry into new',
                            n_current >= 1  & pxl_count < 1 ~ 'exit from historical',
                            n_current < 1  & pxl_count < 1 ~ 'no presence',
                            TRUE ~ 'continued presence')) %>% 
  mutate(pxl_threshold = "1pxl") 

eez_spp_pxls_long_10pxl <- spp_eez_pxl_count %>% 
  # Drop overlapping claim EEZs
  filter(MRGID %in% eez_200nm_list) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("n_RCP"),
               names_to = "scenario",
               values_to = "pxl_count") %>% 
  mutate(scenario = str_remove(scenario, "n_")) %>% 
  # Replace NA with 0, otherwise will be assigned to "continued presence"
  mutate(pxl_count = replace_na(pxl_count, 0),
         n_current = replace_na(n_current, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(spp_change = case_when(n_current < 10 &  pxl_count >= 10 ~ 'entry into new',
                            n_current >= 10  & pxl_count < 10 ~ 'exit from historical',
                            n_current < 10  & pxl_count < 10 ~ 'no presence',
                            TRUE ~ 'continued presence')) %>% 
  mutate(pxl_threshold = "10pxl")  

eez_spp_pxls_long_100pxl <- spp_eez_pxl_count %>% 
  # Drop overlapping claim EEZs
  filter(MRGID %in% eez_200nm_list) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("n_RCP"),
               names_to = "scenario",
               values_to = "pxl_count") %>% 
  mutate(scenario = str_remove(scenario, "n_")) %>% 
  # Replace NA with 0, otherwise will be assigned to "continued presence"
  mutate(pxl_count = replace_na(pxl_count, 0),
         n_current = replace_na(n_current, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(spp_change = case_when(n_current < 100 &  pxl_count >= 100 ~ 'entry into new',
                            n_current >= 100  & pxl_count < 100 ~ 'exit from historical',
                            n_current < 100  & pxl_count < 100 ~ 'no presence',
                            TRUE ~ 'continued presence')) %>% 
  mutate(pxl_threshold = "100pxl")  
                      
```

```{r}
eez_spp_pxls_long_all <- bind_rows(eez_spp_pxls_long_1pxl, eez_spp_pxls_long_10pxl, eez_spp_pxls_long_100pxl) %>% filter(scenario == "RCP45_2050")
```

```{r}
# Get counts of entry into new, exit from historical etc. by  EEZ region
eez_spp_change_counts_all <- left_join(eez_spp_pxls_long_all, eez_simple) %>% 
  group_by(MRGID, GEONAME, scenario, pxl_threshold, spp_change) %>% 
  summarize(spp_change_count = n()) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
eez_c_f_all <- eez_spp_change_counts_all  %>% 
  mutate(spp_change = str_replace_all(spp_change, " ", "_")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = spp_change, values_from = spp_change_count) %>% 
  mutate(continued_presence = replace_na(continued_presence, 0),
         exit_from_historical = replace_na(exit_from_historical, 0),
         entry_into_new = replace_na(entry_into_new, 0),
         no_presence = replace_na(no_presence, 0)) %>%
  mutate(current_spp = continued_presence + exit_from_historical,
         future_spp = continued_presence + entry_into_new,
         perc_exit = 100 * exit_from_historical/current_spp,
         perc_enter = 100 * entry_into_new/current_spp,
         spp_change = future_spp - current_spp,
         ssi = (2 * continued_presence)/(current_spp + future_spp)) 
```

## Plot species pixels
Only include 200 nm EEZs (no overlapping claims or joint regimes)

```{r}
spp_entry_pxls_45_2050 <- spp_entry_pxls %>% 
  filter(scenario == "RCP45_2050") %>% 
  filter(MRGID %in% eez_200nm_list)

spp_exit_pxls_45_2050 <- spp_exit_pxls %>% 
  filter(scenario == "RCP45_2050") %>% 
  filter(MRGID %in% eez_200nm_list)
```

```{r}
# Plot EEZ entry pixels
plot_entry_1_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = globe, fill = "white", color = "black")+  
  geom_sf(data = eez_simple_sf) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  geom_tile(data = spp_entry_pxls_45_2050, aes(x = x, y = y,
                                               fill = n_entry_spp,
                                               color = n_entry_spp)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(1, 28), 
                      breaks = c(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 28),
                      direction = -1,
                      trans = "log", # visually stretches the lower value data
                      guide = guide_colorbar(
                      barwidth  = unit(5, "cm"),   # wide bar for bottom placement
                      barheight = unit(0.4, "cm"),
                      ticks = TRUE,
                      ticks.colour = "white",
                      ticks.linewidth = 0.8
  )) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(limits = c(1,28), 
                        breaks = c(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 28),
                        direction = -1,
                        trans = "log", # visually stretches the lower value data
                        guide = "none")  +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-90, 90)) +
  theme_void() + 
  labs(fill = "species entry count",
       color = "species entry count",
       x = "",
       y = "") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt")) 
```

```{r}
plot_entry_1_density <- ggplot(spp_entry_pxls_45_2050, aes(x = y)) +
  geom_density(fill = "forestgreen", alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-90, 90)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "",
       y = "") +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
```

```{r}
entry_combined_plot <- plot_entry_1_map + plot_entry_1_density + 
  plot_annotation(title = "Species entry, RCP 4.5 2050") +
  plot_layout(widths = c(4, 1),
              axis_titles = "collect",
              guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") 
```

## Bivariate plot

Code created with assistance from Claude to categorize the raster entry and exit pixels into a bivariate color scheme using the following categories to create a 3x3 grid:
* 0 species entry and 0 species exit
* 0 species entry and 1 species exit
* 1 species entry and 0 species exit
* 1 species entry and 1 species exit
* 2+ species entry and 2+ species exit

```{r}
# Merge the entry and exit dataframes so that there are the same number of pixels in each raster
spp_entry_exit_45_2050 <- full_join(spp_entry_pxls_45_2050, spp_exit_pxls_45_2050) %>% 
  # Replace NA with 0
  mutate(n_entry_spp = replace_na(n_entry_spp, 0),
         n_exit_spp = replace_na(n_exit_spp, 0))
```

```{r}
# Test with the territories entry/exit data (so no more HI pixels) Merge the entry and exit dataframes so that there are the same number of pixels in each raster
spp_entry_exit_45_2050 <- full_join(spp_entry_pxls_ter %>% rename(n_entry_spp = N), spp_exit_pxls_ter %>% rename(n_exit_spp = N)) %>% 
  # Replace NA with 0
  mutate(n_entry_spp = replace_na(n_entry_spp, 0),
         n_exit_spp = replace_na(n_exit_spp, 0))
```

```{r}
# Create a new column that categorizes the number of species entry and exit into 3 categories: 0, 1, and 2+
spp_entry_exit_cat_45_2050 <- spp_entry_exit_45_2050 %>% 
  # Assign numeric_category
  mutate(entry_cat = case_when(n_entry_spp == 0 ~ 1,
                               n_entry_spp == 1 ~ 2,
                               n_entry_spp >= 2 ~ 3),
         exit_cat = case_when(n_exit_spp == 0 ~ 1,
                              n_exit_spp == 1 ~ 2,
                              n_exit_spp >= 2 ~ 3)) %>% 
  # Create a new column that combines the entry and exit categories into a single category
  mutate(entry_exit_cat = (exit_cat - 1) * 3 + entry_cat)
```

```{r}
# Define numeric categories for the bivariate color scheme
bivar_levels <- data.frame(
  entry_exit_cat    = 1:9,
  label = c(
    "En0_Ex0", "En1_Ex0", "En2_Ex0",   # exits = 0
    "En0_Ex1", "En1_Ex1", "En2_Ex1",   # exits = 1
    "En0_Ex2", "En1_Ex2", "En2_Ex2"    # exits = 2+
  )
)
spp_entry_exit_cat_45_2050 <- left_join(spp_entry_exit_cat_45_2050, bivar_levels)
```

```{r}
# Color palette
# Entries increase left → right (blue axis)
# Exits increase bottom → top (pink/purple axis)
bivar_colors <- c(
  "En0_Ex0" = "#e8e8e8",  # entries=0,   exits=0
  "En1_Ex0" = "#ace4e4",  # entries=1, exits=0
  "En2_Ex0" = "#5ac8c8",  # entries=2+,  exits=0
  "En0_Ex1" = "#dfb0d6",  # entries=0,   exits=1
  "En1_Ex1" = "#a5add3",  # entries=1, exits=1
  "En2_Ex1" = "#5698b9",  # entries=2+,  exits=1
  "En0_Ex2" = "#be64ac",  # entries=0,   exits=2+
  "En1_Ex2" = "#8c62aa",  # entries=1, exits=2+
  "En2_Ex2" = "#3b4994"   # entries=2+,  exits=2+
)
```

```{r}
biplot <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = globe, fill = "white", color = "black")+
  geom_sf(data = eez_simple_sf, fill = "#e8e8e8") +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  geom_tile(data = spp_entry_exit_cat_45_2050, aes(x = x, y = y,
                                              fill = label,
                                              color = label)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = bivar_colors, na.value = "white") +
  scale_color_manual(values = bivar_colors, na.value = "white") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(#title = "Species exits vs entries, RCP 4.5 2050",
       x = "",
       y = "")
```

```{r}
# Create legend for bivariate color scheme
legend_df <- expand.grid(entries = 1:3, exits = 1:3)
legend_df$label <- paste0("En", legend_df$entries - 1, "_Ex", legend_df$exits - 1)

legend_biplot <- ggplot(legend_df, aes(x = entries, y = exits, fill = label)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = bivar_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = c("0", "1", "2+")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = c("0", "1", "2+")) +
  labs(x = "Entries →", y = "Exits →") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text       = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```

```{r}
# Combine plot
bivariate_map <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(biplot,    0,    0,    1,    1) +
  draw_plot(legend_biplot, 0.75, 0.75, 0.2, 0.25)
```

## Biplot in Pacific-centered plot (0-360 longitude)

```{r}
# Shift tile centroids from -180/180 to 0/360 so the Pacific sits in the
# middle of the plot instead of at the edges
spp_entry_exit_cat_45_2050_pacific <- spp_entry_exit_cat_45_2050 %>%
  mutate(x_shift = ifelse(x < 0, x + 360, x))
```

```{r}
# Claude - Sonnet 5
# Countries straddle different meridians -- Russia/Fiji/Alaska cross
# +/-180, while France/Spain/UK/Ghana cross lon 0 -- so any single
# wrap-then-relabel pass (st_wrap_dateline + st_shift_longitude, or a
# modular coordinate shift) leaves some ring unsplit, which gets drawn
# as a horizontal line spanning the whole plot.
#
# Simpler and more robust: duplicate each layer with a copy shifted by
# +360 degrees longitude, then let coord_sf's xlim = c(0, 360) clip the
# display window. For every country, whichever copy (original or +360)
# happens to land inside the window will be a complete, unbroken ring;
# the other copy falls entirely outside and is just clipped away. No
# ring-splitting is needed because ggplot never has to render a polygon
# that straddles the window edge.
duplicate_shift_lon <- function(x) {
  x_shifted <- st_set_geometry(x, st_geometry(x) + c(360, 0)) %>%
    st_set_crs(st_crs(x))
  bind_rows(x, x_shifted)
}

globe_pacific_shift <- duplicate_shift_lon(globe)
eez_simple_sf_pacific_shift <- duplicate_shift_lon(eez_simple_sf)
```

```{r}
biplot_pacific <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = globe_pacific_shift, fill = "white", color = "black") +
  geom_sf(data = eez_simple_sf_pacific_shift, fill = "#e8e8e8") +
  geom_tile(data = spp_entry_exit_cat_45_2050_pacific,
            aes(x = x_shift, y = y, fill = label, color = label)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = bivar_colors, na.value = "white") +
  scale_color_manual(values = bivar_colors, na.value = "white") +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(0, 360), expand = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "", y = "")
```

```{r}
# Combine with the same legend used for the original biplot
bivariate_map_pacific <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(biplot_pacific,    0,    0,    1,    1) +
  draw_plot(legend_biplot, 0.75, 0.75, 0.2, 0.25)

biplot_pacific
```

```{r}
biplot_density <-ggplot() +
  geom_density(data = spp_exit_pxls_45_2050, aes(x = y),fill = "#be64ac", color = "#be64ac", alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  geom_density(data = spp_entry_pxls_45_2050, aes(x = y),fill = "#5698b9", color = "#5698b9", alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-90, 90)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "",
       y = "") +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
```

# Top species entry / exit by EEZ
Group EEZ regions into terretories and sovereign nations. 

```{r}
# Organize dataframe so that's it's easier to select a scenario and compare to current
eez_spp_pxls_long <- spp_eez_pxl_count %>% 
  # Drop overlapping claim EEZs
  filter(MRGID %in% eez_200nm_list) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("n_RCP"),
               names_to = "scenario",
               values_to = "pxl_count") %>% 
  mutate(scenario = str_remove(scenario, "n_")) %>% 
  # Replace NA with 0, otherwise will be assigned to "continued presence"
  mutate(pxl_count = replace_na(pxl_count, 0),
         n_current = replace_na(n_current, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(spp_change = case_when(n_current < 1 &  pxl_count >= 1 ~ 'entry into new',
                            n_current >= 1  & pxl_count < 1 ~ 'exit from historical',
                            n_current < 1  & pxl_count < 1 ~ 'no presence',
                            TRUE ~ 'continued presence'))
```

```{r}
# Try applying species entries / exits by territories and sovereign EEZ
eez_spp_pxls_long_sov <- left_join(spp_eez_pxl_count %>% filter(MRGID %in% eez_200nm_list), eez_simple) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("n_RCP"),
               names_to = "scenario",
               values_to = "pxl_count") %>% 
  mutate(scenario = str_remove(scenario, "n_")) %>% 
  # Replace NA with 0, otherwise will be assigned to "continued presence"
  mutate(pxl_count = replace_na(pxl_count, 0),
         n_current = replace_na(n_current, 0)) %>% 
  # Group by territory and sovereign EEZ to calcualte species entry and exit
  group_by(ISO_TER1, ISO_SOV1, scenario, aphiaid) %>% 
  summarize(sum_n_current = sum(n_current),
            sum_pxl_count = sum(pxl_count)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(sov_spp_change = case_when(sum_n_current < 1 &  sum_pxl_count >= 1 ~ 'entry into new',
                            sum_n_current >= 1  & sum_pxl_count < 1 ~ 'exit from historical',
                            sum_n_current < 1  & sum_pxl_count < 1 ~ 'no presence',
                            TRUE ~ 'continued presence'))
```

```{r}
# Get counts of entry into new, exit from historical etc. by sovereign EEZ only (not separated by territories)
eez_spp_change_sov_counts <- left_join(eez_spp_pxls_long, eez %>% filter(MRGID %in% eez_200nm_list)) %>% 
  group_by(SOVEREIGN1, MRGID_SOV1, scenario, spp_change) %>% 
  summarize(spp_change_count = n()) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# Get counts of entry into new, exit from historical etc. by territory and sovereign EEZ - but only count if the species is entirely new or loss from territory andsovereign EEZ
eez_spp_change_sov_counts_sovonly <- eez_spp_pxls_long_sov  %>% 
  group_by(ISO_TER1, ISO_SOV1, scenario, sov_spp_change) %>% 
  summarize(spp_change_count = n()) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
eez_c_f_sov <- eez_spp_change_sov_counts_sovonly  %>% 
  mutate(sov_spp_change = str_replace_all(sov_spp_change, " ", "_")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = sov_spp_change, values_from = spp_change_count) %>% 
  mutate(continued_presence = replace_na(continued_presence, 0),
         exit_from_historical = replace_na(exit_from_historical, 0),
         entry_into_new = replace_na(entry_into_new, 0),
         no_presence = replace_na(no_presence, 0)) %>%
  mutate(current_spp = continued_presence + exit_from_historical,
         future_spp = continued_presence + entry_into_new,
         perc_exit = 100 * exit_from_historical/current_spp,
         perc_enter = 100 * entry_into_new/current_spp,
         sov_spp_change = future_spp - current_spp,
         ssi = (2 * continued_presence)/(current_spp + future_spp)) 
```


```{r}
# Which species have the most EEZ region entries? Using regions
spp_eez_entry_count <- left_join(eez_spp_pxls_long, eez %>% filter(MRGID %in% eez_200nm_list)) %>% 
  #filter(MRGID %in% eez_200nm_list) %>%
  filter(spp_change == "entry into new") %>% 
  group_by(aphiaid, scenario) %>% 
  summarise(n_eez_entry = n()) %>% 
  ungroup()

# Which species have the most EEZ region exits? Using regions
spp_eez_exit_count <- left_join(eez_spp_pxls_long, eez %>% filter(MRGID %in% eez_200nm_list)) %>% 
  #filter(MRGID %in% eez_200nm_list) %>%
  filter(spp_change == "exit from historical") %>% 
  group_by(aphiaid, scenario) %>% 
  summarise(n_eez_entry = n()) %>% 
  ungroup()

# which species enter the most EEZ ergions - using only sovereignties/territories
spp_eez_entry_count_sov <- eez_spp_pxls_long_sov %>% 
  #filter(MRGID %in% eez_200nm_list) %>%
  filter(sov_spp_change == "entry into new") %>% 
  group_by(aphiaid, scenario) %>% 
  summarise(n_sov_eez_entry = n()) %>% 
  ungroup()

# Which species have the most EEZ region exits - using sovereignties/territories
spp_eez_exit_count_sov <- eez_spp_pxls_long_sov %>% 
  #filter(MRGID %in% eez_200nm_list) %>%
  filter(sov_spp_change == "exit from historical") %>% 
  group_by(aphiaid, scenario) %>% 
  summarise(n_sov_eez_exit = n()) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

Now, France, North Korea, United Kingdom, Russia, and United Kingdom are the top five for species entry. France is also at the top of the list for species exits with 227 species exits (for France, across their EEZ subparts there are 227 instances of species entirely leaving EEZ regions - pretty interesting). In comparision, there are 11 species exits for France if you dissolve the subparts of their EEZ.

## Bivariate plot

Code created with assistance from Claude Sonnet 4.6 to categorize the raster entry and exit pixels into a bivariate color scheme using the following categories to create a 4x4 grid:
* 0 species entry and 0 species exit
* 0 species entry and 1 species exit
* 1 species entry and 0 species exit
* 1 species entry and 1 species exit
* 2 species entry and 2 species exit
* 3+ species entry and 3+ species exit
* etc

```{r}
# Merge the entry and exit dataframes so that there are the same number of pixels in each raster
spp_entry_exit_45_2050 <- full_join(spp_entry_pxls_45_2050, spp_exit_pxls_45_2050) %>% 
  # Replace NA with 0
  mutate(n_entry_spp = replace_na(n_entry_spp, 0),
         n_exit_spp = replace_na(n_exit_spp, 0))
```

```{r}
# Test with the territories entry/exit data (so no more HI pixels) Merge the entry and exit dataframes so that there are the same number of pixels in each raster
spp_entry_exit_45_2050 <- full_join(spp_entry_pxls_ter %>% rename(n_entry_spp = N), spp_exit_pxls_ter %>% rename(n_exit_spp = N)) %>% 
  # Replace NA with 0
  mutate(n_entry_spp = replace_na(n_entry_spp, 0),
         n_exit_spp = replace_na(n_exit_spp, 0))
```

```{r}
# Create a new column that categorizes the number of species entry and exit into 3 categories: 0, 1, and 2+
spp_entry_exit_cat_45_2050 <- spp_entry_exit_45_2050 %>% 
  # Assign numeric_category
  mutate(entry_cat = case_when(n_entry_spp == 0 ~ 1,
                               n_entry_spp == 1 ~ 2,
                               n_entry_spp == 2 ~ 3,
                               n_entry_spp >= 3 ~ 4),
         exit_cat = case_when(n_exit_spp == 0 ~ 1,
                              n_exit_spp == 1 ~ 2,
                              n_exit_spp == 2 ~ 3,
                              n_exit_spp >= 3 ~ 4)) %>% 
  # Create a new column that combines the entry and exit categories into a single category
  mutate(entry_exit_cat = (exit_cat - 1) * 4 + entry_cat)
```

```{r}
# Define numeric categories for the bivariate color scheme
bivar_levels <- data.frame(
  entry_exit_cat    = 1:16,
  label = c(
    "En0_Ex0", "En1_Ex0", "En2_Ex0", "En3_Ex0",   # exits = 0
    "En0_Ex1", "En1_Ex1", "En2_Ex1", "En3_Ex1",   # exits = 1
    "En0_Ex2", "En1_Ex2", "En2_Ex2", "En3_Ex2",   # exits = 2
    "En0_Ex3", "En1_Ex3", "En2_Ex3", "En3_Ex3"    # exits = 3+
  )
)
spp_entry_exit_cat_45_2050 <- left_join(spp_entry_exit_cat_45_2050, bivar_levels)
```

```{r}
# Color palette
# Entries increase left → right (blue axis)
# Exits increase bottom → top (pink/purple axis)
bivar_colors <- c(
  "En0_Ex0" = "#e8e8e8",  # entries=0,  exits=0
  "En1_Ex0" = "#c2e4e4",  # entries=1,  exits=0
  "En2_Ex0" = "#8bd4d4",  # entries=2,  exits=0
  "En3_Ex0" = "#5ac8c8",  # entries=3+, exits=0

  "En0_Ex1" = "#e4c8df",  # entries=0,  exits=1
  "En1_Ex1" = "#c0c4d8",  # entries=1,  exits=1
  "En2_Ex1" = "#8ab5ce",  # entries=2,  exits=1
  "En3_Ex1" = "#5698b9",  # entries=3+, exits=1

  "En0_Ex2" = "#d4a0cc",  # entries=0,  exits=2
  "En1_Ex2" = "#b09dc4",  # entries=1,  exits=2
  "En2_Ex2" = "#8a8fba",  # entries=2,  exits=2
  "En3_Ex2" = "#5a7aaa",  # entries=3+, exits=2

  "En0_Ex3" = "#be64ac",  # entries=0,  exits=3+
  "En1_Ex3" = "#8c62aa",  # entries=1,  exits=3+
  "En2_Ex3" = "#5a5ea0",  # entries=2,  exits=3+
  "En3_Ex3" = "#3b4994"   # entries=3+, exits=3+
)

```

```{r}
biplot <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = globe, fill = "white", color = "black")+
  geom_sf(data = eez_simple_sf, fill = "#f4f4f4") +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  # Plot pixels at 3x size to help with visualization
  geom_tile(data = spp_entry_exit_cat_45_2050, width = 0.15, height = 0.15, aes(x = x, y = y,
                                              fill = label,
                                              color = label)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = bivar_colors, na.value = "#f4f4f4") +
  scale_color_manual(values = bivar_colors, na.value = "#f4f4f4") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(#title = "Species exits vs entries, RCP 4.5 2050",
       x = "",
       y = "")
```

```{r}
# Create legend for bivariate color scheme
legend_df <- expand.grid(entries = 1:4, exits = 1:4)
legend_df$label <- paste0("En", legend_df$entries - 1, "_Ex", legend_df$exits - 1)

legend_biplot <- ggplot(legend_df, aes(x = entries, y = exits, fill = label)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = bivar_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:4, labels = c("0", "1", "2", "3+")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:4, labels = c("0", "1", "2", "3+")) +
  labs(x = "Entries →", y = "Exits →") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text       = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```

